bays.restriction: On-street pay-by-phone bays (PayByPhone location 805635) — first hour free, session must be booked
bays.times: Pay-by-phone bay charging hours are shown on the bay signs; the council's location table does not publish per-location hours. Maximum stay 4 hours, no return within 2 hours (council 'Where you can park' page)
bays.tariff: Major Onstreet tariff (tariff code TC1). First hour FREE — the free session must still be booked through PayByPhone, one free hour per location per day. Then by CO2 band: up to 2 hours £5.60 (0-100 g/km) rising to £6.70 (over 256 g/km); up to 4 hours £12.30 rising to £13.30. Pre-Euro-6 diesel surcharge +20p (up to 2 hrs) / +50p (4 hrs). Motorcycles £3.00 flat up to 4 hours. (London Gazette notice 4863677, Schedule 5; charges from May 2025)

bays.road: Axe Street Service Road car park
bays.times: Open and charging at all times, all days. Maximum stay 4 hours, no return within 2 hours
bays.tariff: First hour free (register on PayByPhone); up to 2 hours £4.60-£5.60 and up to 4 hours £10.00-£11.10 by CO2 band. Pre-Euro-6 diesel surcharge +20p (1 hr) / +50p (4 hrs). (London Gazette notice 4863677, Schedule 1; charges from May 2025) Blue Badge holders: 4 hours free in a designated disabled bay (council car parks page).

bays.times: Charging 8.00am-8.00pm all days, with overnight rates 8.00pm-8.00am. Maximum stay 12 hours, no return within 4 hours. Height restriction 2.05m (6ft 9in)
bays.tariff: By CO2 band: up to 1 hour £1.20-£1.70; 2 hours £3.50-£4.60; 4 hours £5.60-£7.20; 6 hours £7.90-£8.90; 8 hours £13.30-£14.40; 12 hours £23.10-£24.20. Overnight Sun-Thu £7.90-£8.90, Fri-Sat £16.50-£17.00. Season tickets available. (London Gazette notice 4863677, Schedule 1; charges from May 2025) Blue Badge holders: 4 hours free in a designated disabled bay (council car parks page).

bays.restriction: Residential Parking Zone East Ham — permit holders only during the restricted hours; visitors can pay in shared-use bays
bays.tariff: Paid bays in this zone charge by emissions tier (per hour): Tier 1 (0–50 g/km) £2.00; Tier 2 (51–110) £2.90; Tier 3 (111–170) £3.80; Tier 4 (171–225) £4.70; Tier 5 (226+) £5.60; diesel surcharge £1.00 per hour. At 30-minute maximum-stay locations the same tiers charge per 30 minutes: £1.00 / £1.45 / £1.90 / £2.35 / £2.80, diesel +50p. Resident permits by emissions tier (12 months / 1 month): Tier 1 £33.00 / £3.30; Tier 2 £66.00 / £6.60; Tier 3 £110.00 / £11.00; Tier 4 £165.00 / £16.50; Tier 5 £220.00 / £22.00 (Newham Council resident permit costs)
bays.pay: PayByPhone (phone 020 7005 0055) in shared-use bays; permits via MiPermit
